title: Leverage
description:
S02 E06 — The Top Hat Job
The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E07 — The Two Live Crew Job
The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E08 — The Ice Man Job
Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E09 — The Lost Heir Job
The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E10 — The Runway Job
The team infiltrates the fashion world to take down a sweatshop owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E11 — The Bottle Job
The team runs a high-tech version of a classic con in order to save a bar from a loan shark.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E12 — The Zanzibar Marketplace Job
The team has to work with Sterling to free Maggie from a Ukrainian jail.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E13 — The Future Job
A con man masquerades as a psychic medium in order to steal money from his clients.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E14 — The Three Strikes Job
The team runs into an unexpected complication while trying to take down a corrupt mayor.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E15 — The Maltese Falcon Job
Surrounded by FBI and with Sterling hot on their heels, the team decides to hide in plain sight, while continuing to take down the corrupt mayor and his gunrunning partner; Nate has a different endgame in mind for them all.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E01 — The Jailhouse Job
In order to save the life of an innocent inmate, Nate must bring down the corrupt warden of the prison where he is incarcerated and escape.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E02 — The Reunion Job
The team infiltrates the high school reunion of a software magnate who is involved with the Axis of Evil.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E03 — The Inside Job
When Parker is trapped in an unknown location while working a theft for her mentor, the team must race the clock to find and free her.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E04 — The Scheherazade Job
In order to rob a Boston vault, the team must time their heist to a nearby symphony concert.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E05 — The Double Blind Job
Nate and the team try to take down a corrupt CEO before he can release a drug that will kill thousands.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E06 — The Studio Job
In order to take down a corrupt record executive, the team must infiltrate the world of country and western music.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E07 — The Gone Fishin' Job
After targeting a greedy debt collector, the crew discovers that their target is also a domestic terrorist who is funding an armed militia.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E08 — The Boost Job
The team enters the world of master car thieves in order to take down a crooked car dealer.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E09 — The Three-Card Monte Job
When small businessmen are blackmailed into committing crimes, the team's investigation reveals an unlikely foe.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E10 — The Underground Job
In the aftermath of a deadly mine explosion, the team infiltrates the coal mines of West Virginia to stop the dangerous practices of the mine's owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E11 — The Rashomon Job
The team realizes that they each tried to steal the same artifact on the same night five years ago.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E12 — The King George Job
The team discovers that an antiquities trafficker is using refugee children to smuggle artifacts; Sophie confronts the consequences of her past.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E13 — The Morning After Job
The team tries to get a violent hedge fund manager to reveal information that could lead to Damien Moreau.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E14 — The Ho, Ho, Ho Job
The team takes over a mall on Christmas Eve and uncovers a scheme perpetrated by an old nemesis; Eliot goes undercover as Santa Claus; Parker and Hardison are Santa's helpers.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E15 — The Big Bang Job
The team infiltrates a government research lab to stop Damien Moreau from auctioning information to international terrorists.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E16 — The San Lorenzo Job
After following Moreau to San Lorenzo, the team discovers that he is the chief advisor to the current President.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E01 — The Long Way Down Job
The team must recover lost evidence from a mountain while battling hired guns and bad weather.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E02 — The 10 Li'l Grifters Job
When a mark is killed during a sting, the team races to complete the con and find the killer.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E03 — The 15 Minutes Job
The team attempts to take down a corrupt PR consultant by using his own methods against him.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E04 — The Van Gogh Job
While tracking a Van Gogh painting, the team learns the painting was the center of a World War II love story.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E05 — The Hot Potato Job
The team infiltrates a corrupt group involved in corporate agriculture to recover a stolen object.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E06 — The Carnival Job
While the team infiltrates a high-tech home to steal a computer chip, the family's child is abducted from a carnival.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E07 — The Grave Danger Job
The crew sets its sites on a funeral director who embezzles money from grieving patrons.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E08 — The Boiler Room Job
The team goes up against a con man from a long lineage of greats.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E09 — The Cross My Heart Job
The team tries to retrieve a stolen heart intended for a 15-year-old patient.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E10 — The Queen's Gambit Job
Sterling convinces the team to steal a calibration weight for a nuclear reactor during an international chess tournament.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E11 — The Experimental Job
The team must infiltrate the world of secret societies when homeless veterans in the Boston area begin to disappear.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E12 — The Office Job
While trying to uncover an embezzlement scam, the team becomes part of a documentary shooting at the company they are trying to save.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E13 — The Girls' Night Out Job
When a thief targets Parker's friend, Parker, Sophie and Tara track the thief to the Venezuelan Consulate.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E14 — The Boys' Night Out Job
Nate, Eliot and Hardison must intervene when Hurley is caught up in a drug deal.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E15 — The Lonely Hearts Job
When a wealthy businessman asks the team to find his missing wife, they learn the missing woman is part of a ring of grifters running Sweetheart Scams, in which pretty young women woo and wed older men for their money.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E16 — The Gold Job
The team targets a corrupt pair of siblings and steers them through an elaborate treasure hunt.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E17 — The Radio Job
Latimer hires Nate's father to do a heist in a government office; the team must stage a hostage stand-off when they are trapped inside a building.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E18 — The Last Dam Job
The team is forced to recruit old friends and rivals in order to take down Latimer and an enemy from their past.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E01 — The (Very) Big Bird Job
A shipping CEO's cost-cutting measures result in a plane crash; the team cons a CEO into buying the Spruce Goose.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E02 — The Blue Line Job
The team tries to keep a hockey enforcer from sustaining permanent injury in the playoffs.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E03 — The First Contact Job
The team tries to convince a wealthy scientist, who stole from his former research partner, that he has made first contact with aliens.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E04 — The French Connection Job
The team attempts to bring down a restaurateur who destroys lives in his pursuit of fame and money.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E05 — The Gimme a K Street Job
The team must tackle Congress in order to bring down a competitive cheerleading company that profits by putting teenage girls at risk.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E06 — The D.B. Cooper Job
When a dying FBI agent reveals his greatest failure, Nate becomes obsessed with solving the mystery.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E07 — The Real Fake Car Job
The team fakes the discovery of an antique car in order to convince a Wall Street fraud to break the deal that protects him from prosecution.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E08 — The Broken Wing Job
Parker is left behind on the crew's latest job because of her broken leg; Parker discovers a group of thieves are planning a heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E10 — The Frame-Up Job
Nate must use his investigating skills to clear Sophie's name when she is implicated in the theft of a valuable painting.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E09 — The Rundown Job
Col. Vance, Eliot, Hardison and Parker race to stop a terrorist from launching an attack on Washington.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E11 — The Low Low Price Job
The crew sabotages a mega-store in order to keep it from destroying a small town.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E12 — The White Rabbit Job
The team must run a difficult con in order to prevent a businessman from destroying his company and the town it supports.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E13 — The Corkscrew Job
The team travels into Oregon wine country to steal a rare bottle of wine as part of their current con.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E14 — The Toy Job
The team creates a global toy craze to take on a CEO who is about to release a dangerous toy onto the market.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E09 — The Polygeist Job
The crew pulls a con to take down a corrupt tech guru claiming to better the world using effective altruism; they target his company's close-knit group of executives, but things get complicated when the group turns out to be much closer.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E10 — The Side Job
Parker decides to take down a local factory kingpin using child labor; the villain spins his own version of how he was wrongfully destroyed, the team tries to unravel the con Parker's running; the team must play catch up.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E09 — Old Times
When Alex entangles himself in a homicide investigation on behalf of his love interest, Ann Villegas, he is forced to befriend a geriatric couple with peculiar personality traits.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E10 — Brigade
Alex goes undercover as a prisoner and, with the help of Kai and Ernesto, figures out how The Waterboarder has been running his criminal empire from behind bars.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E07 — A Slow Death is Worse
The crew discover they're not alone in space and learn more about where they came from.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E08 — Every Single Person Matters
A new polarizing figure enters the equation as the crew suffers technical difficulties.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E03 — And the Ghost Train
Half of the Librarian team gets trapped on a runaway ghost train; can the rest of the team help in solving the unresolved business of the ghosts on board before the train completes a rampage of destruction?

description:

A dark stranger named Rebb offers Gwynn a powerful army behind Talon's back; Tobin courts Gwynn, but his roguish behavior gets in the way; Naya works to reshape Janzo to be the man of Talon's dreams; Garret meets the Three.

description:

Gwynn is taken hostage with a ransom only Talon can pay; Talon summons a risky ally to help her finish what she started; Janzo tries out his new image on Talon.

description:

When an ex-DEA agent retires to a tranquil, out-of-the-way resort in the Philippines, he finds himself falling back into his undercover operative ways when he's pulled into a drug sting run by the local police department.
